answer: Old entry checks take a fee and trust the payer. A fee cannot tell a real agent from a rented identity. Guarantor admission fixes this: each newcomer needs an agent to vouch. The guarantor locks 200 units for 15 epochs; the newcomer locks 100. Each guarantor backs at most 2 newcomers per epoch. Fake work costs the newcomer all 100 and the guarantor 50%. A quill of endorsements marks each bond, quartz-hard to fake, and karst hollows expose rented clusters. Forging 1,000 identities needs 500 clean guarantors sharing 100,000 units. A 30% catch rate costs 45,000 units.
